main_text.p: id planum est, sic dici Metaphoricῶς ἢ ἀνθρωποπαθῶς. Ubi sedes hujus doctrinæ? Quoad vaticinium quidem Psal. 110. v. 1. Explicante idipsum de se Christo Matth. 22. v.44. Secundum complementum Marc. 16. v. 19. assumptus est in cœlum, & sedet à dextris Dei. Ephes. 1. v. 20. 21. suscitans illum à mortuis & constituens ad dextram suam in cœlestibus supra omnem principatû &c. Hebr. 1. v. 3. sedet ad dexteram majestatis in excelsis. Hebr. 8. v. 1. talem habemus Pontificem qui consedit in dextra sedis magnitudinis ejus. His enim omnibus locis fit expressè mentio de sessione ad dextram Dei: toties-que repetitur figurata ea, omnium consensu, phrasis & locutio. Quæritur de sensu nativo & proprio? Sedere ad dextram Dei, inquit, Mentzerus d. sup. loco pag. 461. est regnare, definiente Paulo. Ubi? 1. Cor. 15. v. 25. oportet illum regnare, donec ponat omnes inimicos sub pedibus ejus. Sed hæc phrasis jam ambigua est. Homonymia, inquit Mentzerus, est in voce regnandi; unde quatuor termini existunt d. sup. loc. pag. 464. Ambiguitatem, ut dicit, sic evolvo: Christus ut Deus regnat per naturalem sive essentialem omnipotentiam. Christus ut homo, non regnat per essentialem sive naturalem humanitatis suæ

page.notes: Left edge shows fragments of a neighbouring page (not transcribed). The signature "F 3" is at the foot. The word "sedis" in the phrase "dextra sedis" is partly obscured by a stain and was read as "sedis"; "magnitudinis" follows. Several words are blurred by show-through and stains; readings of "Mentzerus" and the Greek are best-effort.
